details: TD Cowen analysts indicate that CME Group holds a strong position in its lawsuit against the CFTC. The dispute centers on the regulatory classification of perpetual contracts as futures rather than swaps, introducing uncertainty into the crypto derivatives market.
title: CME Group Sued Over Crypto Perpetual Futures Classification.

details: An infinite-mint exploit on the Secret Network's Axelar bridge led to a loss of $4.67 million, reportedly going unnoticed for a week. This security breach highlights persistent vulnerabilities within cross-chain bridge technologies.
title: Secret Network's Axelar Bridge Suffers $4.67M Exploit.

details: Japan's National Commercial Enterprise Pension Fund is reportedly planning to invest in cryptocurrencies starting in fiscal year 2026. This move signals a growing trend of institutional adoption and broader acceptance of digital assets.
title: Japan's National Pension Fund Plans Crypto Allocation.

details: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) is reportedly preparing to greenlight tokenized stock trading. This development could significantly reshape U.S. equity markets by integrating traditional finance with blockchain technology.
title: SEC Nears Approval for Tokenized Stock Trading.

details: Bitcoin exchange-traded fund (ETF) outflows have seen a dramatic 87% reduction, falling from a peak of $1.72 billion to $226 million last week. This significant decline in redemptions suggests a potential shift in market sentiment and reduced selling pressure from investors.
title: Bitcoin ETF Outflows Plummet by 87%.

details: Morgan Stanley's proposed 0.14% fees for its Ethereum (ETH) and Solana (SOL) ETFs are notably low, suggesting an impending price war within the competitive crypto ETF market. This could offer investors more affordable access to these digital assets.
title: Morgan Stanley's Low ETH/SOL ETF Fees Signal Price War.
